name: BENCH-v1
purpose: Small, fixed, data-rich subset for the automation loop: rank where CPU, memory and failures go, fix the biggest item, rerun. Judge a change by its delta across every function here.

overlays.name: berlinGasCalc
overlays.why: berlinGasCalc is not on main. This measurement-only branch (two commits on main 670878e92) adds its contracts, hints, entries, callers, the stock-zisk roots and the binding of its stock trace theory, taken from the held-out column worktree heldout-w0-bslog (ca6e02a87; entries and callers from its latest render, closed set 9/9). The clean reserve (hpDecode, resumeCall) contracts, entries, callers and trace theories are left out; build/stock-zisk keeps all three roots because it is generated for the three together. The native trace cache is the one the held-out columns use. bench.py merges this commit into the measured head.
